content_sections.heading: About IIMU
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Udaipur is a management institute in Udaipur. These interns will work in its Executive Education office, which runs programmes for working professionals and client organisations. They will report to the Head, Executive Education.

content_sections.heading: IIMU Intern - Executive Education Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You need at least a bachelor's degree. Candidates who are currently studying for a master's degree or have already completed one can also apply. A master's degree is not mandatory. Freshers are encouraged to apply. Candidates with experience in administration or management are also welcome. Good verbal and written communication skills. Basic understanding of administrative tasks and processes. Ability to work with databases and help with social media activities, as required. A professional and courteous approach when dealing with working professionals at different levels. The institute also says the role needs clear communication, the ability to manage things well, data management and the ability to deal with different stakeholders. For the full eligibility details of this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Duties and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Support the Executive Education office in planning and coordinating programmes. Help with day-to-day activities, communication, coordination and other work related to Executive Education programmes. Help coordinate with clients, faculty members and internal teams so that programmes run smoothly. Help prepare presentations, reports, Excel sheets, emails and other programme documents. Use digital tools and AI applications in daily work to improve efficiency. Take up assignments and responsibilities as required across different areas of Executive Education.

content_sections.heading: Internship Terms
content_sections.text: The internship lasts 3 to 6 months. The stipend is Rs. 15-20K per month. Interns report to the Head, Executive Education. Depending on performance and the department's needs, interns may be considered for the position of Junior Assistant.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMU Intern - Executive Education Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the IIM Udaipur website, www.iimu.ac.in . Open the JOBS tab and find the notice for Intern – Executive Education. Use the online application link given there (the notice page also has an "Apply Now" link). Complete and submit the application so that IIMU receives it by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many intern posts has IIM Udaipur advertised?
faq.answer: IIMU has advertised 2 (Two) posts of Intern – Executive Education.

faq.question: Q2. Can a fresh graduate apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The minimum qualification is a bachelor's degree, and the notice says freshers are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need a master's degree?
faq.answer: No. A master's degree is not mandatory, but candidates who are studying for one or have completed one are equally welcome.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: Interns get a stipend of Rs. 15-20K per month for an internship lasting 3 to 6 months.

faq.question: Q5. Can the internship lead to a job at IIMU?
faq.answer: Interns may be considered for the position of Junior Assistant, depending on their performance and the department's needs.

faq.question: Q6. Who will the interns report to?
faq.answer: Interns report to the Head, Executive Education, and support that office in planning and coordinating its programmes.

faq.question: Q7. What skills does the role need?
faq.answer: The role needs good verbal and written communication, a basic understanding of administrative processes, the ability to work with databases and help with social media, and a courteous approach with working professionals.

faq.question: Q8. Where and by when should I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through the JOBS tab on www.iimu.ac.in. Applications must be received by 5 November 2026.
